title: Postmortem
description: One blameless postmortem, at capabilities/postmortems/<id>.json (route capabilities/postmortems/[id]): what happened, its impact, a timeline, the contributing causes as conditions of the process or system and never as people, the corrective and preventive actions with an owner each, and the lessons to reuse. It follows the Google SRE book, chapter 15 (postmortem culture), ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2 (nonconformity and corrective action) and APQC PCF 13.3.3 (manage non-conformance) and 13.4.4.2 (capture lessons learned). The capabilities function owns it, and only its agent (capabilities-agent) or a person writes it (writer function). The agent drafts it; a person reviews it before it closes.

id.description: The postmortem's id, the file name without .json

trigger.description: Which trigger, set in advance, made it owed. Anyone may request one

process.description: The process record (capabilities/processes/<id>.json) it concerns, when one exists

impact.description: Who or what was affected, and how much

contributing_causes.description: Conditions of the process or system the venture controls, never a person's name

handoff.description: The handoff that carries it, by id

lessons.description: What another process or function can reuse

status.description: draft: written by the agent. reviewed: a person reviewed it. closed: every action is done or dropped
